summary: Sandbox image: smoke passes, pre-commit installed, published to GHCR
epic_summary: WS-A Sandbox image (RTEMS toolchain + SIS, pre-commit, GHCR)
description:
Image definition: `sandbox/rtems/Dockerfile` (first build started by Claude on 2026-11-02, local tag `anvil-sandbox-rtems:7`).

## Do

* Make `anvil-smoke` pass inside the image (erc32 BSP builds, `hello.exe` passes on SIS via `rtems-test`). Fix the Dockerfile/smoke script as needed.
* Install `pre-commit` in the image; add `sandbox/rtems/pre-commit-config.rtems.yaml` (clang-format on changed lines, trailing whitespace, cppcheck on changed C files, commit-msg check `^[A-Z]+-[0-9]+: `).
* Push to `ghcr.io/vishal7pandey/anvil-sandbox-rtems:7` (public package), record the digest in `sandbox/rtems/README.md`.
* Document in `sandbox/rtems/README.md`: how to build a BSP, run one test, run the psxtests subset (the agent's skill will quote this).

## Acceptance

* `docker run --rm anvil-sandbox-rtems:7 anvil-smoke` prints `ANVIL SMOKE: PASS` (paste the tail in the PR).
* Running `psx05` on erc32 passes; time for a full erc32 build noted.

comments.body:
[codex] Opened workflow PR: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/7

The PR adds the GHCR build/publish workflow with four build jobs and GHA cache, digest-pinned Syft/OSV Scanner plus Bear/Java/pre-commit, an erc32 smoke check for hello and psx05, and usage/pre-commit docs. `git diff --check` passed. Docker/RTEMS validation is deferred to Actions; local image and RTEMS locks remain held by Claude.

[codex] Pushed review fixes in commit `fcb7bb7` to PR #7: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/7. Set the Docker build context to `sandbox/rtems`, installed the staged-line formatter in the image and updated the hook entry, and restored the Dockerfile `JOBS=6` default (Actions explicitly passes `JOBS=4`). `git diff --check` passes; ready for re-review.

[codex] PR #7 merged as `facb77d`; the automatic main-branch image workflow is running: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/actions/runs/41482286881. Build and push is in progress; smoke test will run after publishing.

[codex] First image run failed after 75 minutes because the Actions runner exhausted disk space (diagnostic annotation: `No space left on device`). Follow-up PR #18 adds runner cleanup and removes RSB build intermediates in the same Docker layer: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/18. I’m dispatching the updated workflow from this branch to validate the fix.

[claude] First full local build failed after ~4 h in the last package (sis install: `/usr/bin/install-info: not found`); the whole toolchain was one RUN, so nothing was cached. Actions run 41482286881 will fail the same way. Fix: PR https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/19 (install-info, host-tool preflight, cached RSB downloads). Local rebuild from #19 started; ETA ~03:00. Lesson: preflight host tools before multi-hour builds.

[codex] Claude's PR #19 is reviewed and merged as `74c14ee`; it adds `install-info`, a fast host-tool preflight, and BuildKit caches for RSB downloads. The original run 41482286881 had already failed from runner disk exhaustion; my duplicate run 41495066832 was cancelled. The new main-branch build is running: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/actions/runs/41496713294. PR #18 still contains the runner disk cleanup in case this run hits the same issue.

[claude] Local build from main (PR #19) succeeded at 01:17: `anvil-sandbox-rtems:7`, image 15e3705829d0, 5.78 GB. Smoke (erc32 + hello + psx05 on SIS) running; pushing to GHCR as `:7-rc1`, retagged `:7` after the smoke passes. Hosted Actions builds are abandoned (runner disk); Actions only verifies the published image (#20).
